catalogue: Australian building water, heated-water and rainwater plumbing components

objects.name: building water-services system
objects.definition: The coordinated physical network that brings drinking, heated, tempered, non-drinking or rainwater into a property and carries the selected water service to its outlets and connected appliances.
functions: Connect approved water sources to building outlets
Keep water-service types separated and identifiable
Provide isolation, pressure control, protection and maintenance access

ncc_references.relationship: National water-services regulatory context; the applicable standard edition and variations depend on jurisdiction and approval pathway.

cad.pattern: Connected source, distribution and outlet networks with discrete equipment and valves
cad.placement: Across the property from points of connection or storage to every nominated point of discharge
cad.start: Approved water source or point of connection
cad.end: Fixture, appliance, equipment or service outlet
cad.opening: Passes through building elements only through coordinated penetrations and sleeves
cad.load: Hydraulic pressure and equipment loads transferred to supports and structure

notes: WaterMark, Lead Free WaterMark, WELS ratings, design pressure and compliance status are evidence or attributes, not extra solids.

objects.name: cold water service
objects.definition: The pipe, fittings, valves and connected equipment carrying water that is not intentionally heated from its point of connection to the cold-water points of discharge.
functions: Distribute cold water to fixtures and appliances
Maintain suitable pressure and water quality
Permit isolation and maintenance
materials: lead-free valves and fittings where applicable

ncc_references.relationship: Cold-water service from point of connection to points of discharge.

cad.pattern: Branching pressure-pipe network
cad.placement: Below ground, in service cavities, under floors, in ceilings and at fixtures as coordinated
cad.start: Drinking or approved alternative-water point of connection
cad.end: Cold inlet of fixture, appliance, water heater or other outlet
cad.opening: Penetrates structure and linings through coordinated protected openings
cad.load: Pressurised pipe and water mass carried by clips, brackets and supports

notes: Cold describes the service intent; unintended solar or roof-space heating remains a design risk rather than a new pipe object.

objects.name: drinking water service
objects.definition: A cold-water service connected to water accepted for human consumption, food preparation, utensil washing or personal hygiene, using products suitable for contact with drinking water.
functions: Carry drinking water without avoidable contamination
Supply nominated drinking and personal-hygiene outlets
Remain protected from cross-connections

cad.pattern: Protected branch network reserved for drinking-water use
cad.placement: From approved drinking-water source to nominated outlets
cad.start: Network utility or approved alternative drinking-water connection
cad.opening: Requires protected crossings and separation from contamination sources
cad.load: Pressurised water service supported by the building

notes: Potable and drinking water are accepted search terms here; product suitability and actual water quality remain evidence.

objects.name: alternative drinking-water service
objects.definition: A drinking-water service supplied from an approved source other than the normal network utility supply, such as treated roof water, bore water or carted water accepted for the intended use.
functions: Distribute approved alternative drinking water
Keep source treatment and storage connected to the correct outlets
Prevent contamination of any network supply

cad.pattern: Source, treatment, storage and protected distribution network
cad.placement: Across the property between alternative source and approved drinking-water outlets
cad.opening: Separated from unprotected services and contamination hazards
cad.load: Tank and equipment loads plus pressurised distribution

notes: Approval and treatment depend on source, jurisdiction and intended use; the model must not upgrade tank or bore water to drinking water by label alone.

objects.name: non-drinking water service
objects.definition: A separately identified pipe network carrying water that is not intended or approved for drinking, food preparation, utensil washing or personal hygiene to its permitted outlets.
functions: Distribute non-drinking water to permitted uses
Make the service and outlets visibly distinguishable
Prevent unprotected connection to drinking-water systems

ncc_references.relationship: Non-drinking water service boundary and cross-connection context.

cad.pattern: Separately identified branch network
cad.placement: From approved non-drinking source to permitted fixtures, appliances or irrigation connection
cad.opening: Must remain physically distinguishable and protected at crossings
cad.load: Pressurised water service carried by supports

notes: Rainwater is expressly treated as a separate service family in NCC Volume Three Part B6.

objects.name: heated water service
objects.definition: The water heater, storage, valves, temperature controls, pipework, insulation and outlets that intentionally heat drinking or rainwater and distribute it to points of discharge.
functions: Generate or store heated water
Distribute heated water safely
Control expansion, pressure, temperature and relief discharge

ncc_references.relationship: Heated-water service from point of connection to points of discharge.

cad.pattern: Cold inlet, heater or storage, relief paths and branching heated-water distribution
cad.placement: Plant location and service routes to heated-water fixtures
cad.start: Cold-water connection to the heated-water service
cad.end: Heated or tempered points of discharge
cad.opening: Equipment, pipes and drains require coordinated penetrations and service access
cad.load: Full heater and water mass supported by slab, plinth, wall or frame

notes: A water heater is one component; describing the whole pipe-and-control network as the heater hides relief and temperature-control parts.

objects.name: tempered water service
objects.definition: The downstream pipe network carrying water blended or controlled to a selected delivery-temperature limit from a temperature-control device to nominated personal-hygiene outlets.
functions: Deliver temperature-controlled water
Keep controlled outlets connected downstream of the correct device
Retain service access for testing and maintenance
not_synonyms: heated water service upstream of mixing

cad.pattern: Branch network downstream of a temperature-control device
cad.placement: Between mixing or temperature-limiting device and selected outlets
cad.opening: Passes through coordinated service openings
cad.load: Pressurised pipe supported by building fabric

notes: Tempered describes the water service downstream of control, not the entire stored heated-water circuit.

objects.name: rainwater service
objects.definition: The identified pressure-pipe system carrying stored roof-collected rainwater from the tank connection to permitted rainwater points of discharge.
functions: Distribute stored rainwater
Keep rainwater pipework and outlets identifiable
Prevent contamination of drinking-water services
not_synonyms: non-drinking water service under Part B3

ncc_references.relationship: Stored-rainwater distribution from storage connection to points of discharge.

cad.pattern: Tank, pump and separately marked branch distribution
cad.placement: From rainwater tank outlet to approved rainwater uses
cad.opening: Separated and identified where services cross or share plant spaces
cad.load: Pressurised service carried by supports

notes: If roof water is the approved primary source for drinking and personal hygiene, it follows the alternative cold-water pathway rather than being assumed non-drinking.

objects.name: rainwater storage system
objects.definition: The physical tank and its inlet, screening, access, overflow, outlet, drain, base and optional pumping or top-up equipment that receives and stores roof-collected rainwater.
functions: Receive roof water
Store water while excluding light, debris, animals and surface inflow
Supply a cold-water or rainwater service

ncc_references.relationship: Rainwater storage from water entry to connection with the selected water service.

cad.pattern: One or more tanks connected to roof-water inlets, overflow and service outlet
cad.placement: Above ground, partly buried, below ground or within an approved enclosure
cad.opening: Contains screened inlets and overflow plus sealed maintenance openings
cad.load: Full water mass transferred through tank base and foundation; buried units also resist soil and groundwater actions

notes: Detention, firefighting and reuse storage can share a vessel only when each selected role and connection is designed explicitly.

objects.name: backflow protection system
objects.definition: The selected physical air gap, break tank or mechanical-device arrangement that protects a drinking-water service at a property boundary, zone or individual connection from reverse flow.
functions: Interrupt or prevent reverse flow
Protect the nominated upstream drinking-water service
Provide isolation, testing, drainage and access where required

ncc_references.relationship: Cross-connection protection context; assessed hazard is metadata used to select the physical system.

cad.pattern: One protection assembly at containment, zone or individual connection locations
cad.placement: At an accessible protected point upstream of the nominated cross-connection hazard
cad.opening: Relief and air openings remain unobstructed and drain visibly where applicable
cad.load: Device mass and pipe reactions transferred to brackets or slab

notes: Device selection cannot be inferred from appearance; protection type, hazard assessment and jurisdiction are required metadata.

objects.name: water-service point-of-connection assembly
objects.definition: The physical junction where the property water service connects to a network, tank, treatment plant or other approved source, including the nominated pipe and isolation interface.
functions: Define the physical start of the property water service
Connect unlike ownership or system zones
Provide an accessible isolation and identification point
materials: meter or tank outlet as applicable

cad.pattern: One or more discrete connections per approved water source
cad.placement: At network connection, tank outlet or other approved source interface
cad.opening: May occupy a meter or valve box opening
cad.load: Pipe thrust and device weight supported locally

notes: The regulatory point of connection is project metadata attached to the selected physical junction.

objects.name: property water-service pipe
objects.definition: The pressure pipe running from the water-service point of connection into the property to the main distribution or first controlled branch of the building service.
functions: Carry the property water supply
Connect source-side equipment to building distribution
Provide a route for meter, isolation and backflow equipment

cad.pattern: Usually one continuous incoming route with discrete joints and equipment
cad.placement: Between point of connection and building distribution, commonly below ground then rising at entry
cad.end: Main stop valve, manifold or first distribution branch
cad.opening: Passes through ground, footing or wall using coordinated protection
cad.load: Internal pressure and soil or support actions

objects.name: property water-meter assembly
objects.definition: The accessible group containing a water meter and its matching connectors, upstream and downstream pipework, isolation valves and protective box or support where provided.
functions: Measure water passing into the property or zone
Allow meter removal and service isolation
Protect and support the metering equipment

cad.pattern: One assembly per metered service or submetered zone
cad.placement: At an accessible point near the property connection or served zone
cad.opening: Requires reading and replacement access
cad.load: Meter mass and pipe reactions supported by box, bracket or pipe supports

objects.name: water meter
objects.definition: An inline measuring unit with defined inlet and outlet connections that records the volume or flow of water passing through a service.
functions: Measure water use
Provide a readable or remotely readable consumption record
Form the metering element within a meter assembly

cad.pattern: One inline unit in each meter assembly
cad.placement: Between meter assembly connectors in an accessible reading location
cad.opening: Display and communication module remain visible
cad.load: Unit weight supported without imposing harmful strain on pipework

objects.name: water-meter box
objects.definition: A ground, wall or cabinet enclosure protecting a water meter and nearby valves while leaving them accessible for reading, isolation and replacement.
functions: Protect meter equipment
Provide controlled service access
Identify the meter location at the finished surface

cad.pattern: One box around each external meter set where required
cad.placement: At finished ground, wall or service-cabinet level
cad.opening: Has removable lid and pipe penetrations
cad.load: Surface and traffic loads transferred around protected equipment

objects.name: main water-service stop valve
objects.definition: The accessible manually operated valve that shuts off the main incoming water service to the property or building distribution system.
functions: Isolate the complete downstream water service
Provide emergency shut-off
Permit downstream work and testing

cad.pattern: One main isolator per separately isolatable service
cad.placement: Near the point of connection or building entry in a readily accessible location
cad.opening: Handle and operating sweep remain accessible
cad.load: Inline pressure component supported against operating torque

objects.name: below-ground water-valve surface box
objects.definition: A small box and removable marked lid extending from finished surface level down to an otherwise buried water-service valve so the valve can be found and operated.
functions: Keep a buried valve accessible
Identify the water-service control location
Protect the valve operating space from surrounding fill

cad.pattern: One vertical access box above each nominated buried valve
cad.placement: From buried valve to finished surface
cad.opening: Forms a maintained access opening through ground or paving
cad.load: Surface loads bypassed around the protected valve

notes: Some jurisdictional variations expressly require marked boxes for below-ground valves; project location selects the rule.

objects.name: cold-water distribution pipe
objects.definition: A pressure-pipe run within the property that carries cold water from the incoming service, manifold or branch to fixtures, appliances or other water-service equipment.
functions: Convey cold water
Connect branches and outlets
Contain service pressure

cad.pattern: Continuous runs joined into a branching network
cad.placement: In approved service zones, cavities, ceilings, floors and external trenches
cad.start: Stop valve, manifold or upstream branch
cad.opening: Uses sleeves and protection at structure and lining penetrations
cad.load: Internal pressure, water mass and thermal movement carried by supports

objects.name: heated-water distribution pipe
objects.definition: A temperature-rated pressure pipe carrying intentionally heated water from a water heater or storage outlet toward a temperature-control device or point of discharge.
functions: Convey heated water
Connect heater to branches or mixing controls
Limit heat loss when insulated

cad.pattern: Branching flow network from heater to outlets and controls
cad.placement: Within protected service zones between heater and heated-water outlets
cad.end: Temperature-control device, branch or heated-water outlet
cad.opening: Penetrations preserve insulation and building separation
cad.load: Pressurised hot-water pipe with thermal movement supported independently

objects.name: tempered-water pipe
objects.definition: A pressure pipe downstream of a temperature-control device that carries blended or otherwise limited-temperature water to specified outlets.
functions: Convey temperature-controlled water
Keep controlled and uncontrolled branches distinct
Connect control device to nominated outlets
not_synonyms: heated-water distribution pipe upstream of mixing

cad.pattern: Branches only to outlets assigned to the controlling device
cad.placement: Downstream of tempering or thermostatic mixing device
cad.opening: Uses coordinated protected penetrations
cad.load: Pressurised pipe supported by clips and brackets

objects.name: non-drinking-water service pipe
objects.definition: A visibly identified pressure pipe dedicated to conveying non-drinking water to permitted uses without being mistaken for a drinking-water pipe.
functions: Convey non-drinking water
Maintain service identification
Connect only to permitted outlets and equipment
materials: identified polymer or metal pressure pipe

cad.pattern: Separately identified branch network
cad.placement: Between non-drinking source and permitted outlets
cad.opening: Identified at accessible sections and penetrations
cad.load: Pressurised pipe carried by supports

notes: Colour is an identification attribute; a purple-looking pipe does not prove its service, source or approval.

objects.name: rainwater-service pipe
objects.definition: An identified pressure pipe carrying stored rainwater from the tank or pump assembly to a permitted rainwater fixture, appliance or outlet.
functions: Convey stored rainwater
Maintain rainwater identification
Connect the correct tank and outlet branches
not_synonyms: non-drinking water pipe under Part B3

cad.pattern: Identified branch network downstream of rainwater storage
cad.placement: Between tank or pump and approved rainwater outlets
cad.opening: Marked at accessible penetrations and outlets
cad.load: Pressurised pipe carried by supports

objects.name: water-service riser
objects.definition: A generally vertical water-service pipe carrying cold, heated, tempered, non-drinking or rainwater between building levels or from a buried service into the building.
functions: Carry a water service vertically
Connect horizontal service zones on different levels
Provide branch take-offs at nominated heights

cad.pattern: One vertical run per service or pressure zone with level branches
cad.placement: Service shaft, wall cavity or protected external route
cad.opening: Passes through floors using sleeves, firestops and acoustic treatment as applicable
cad.load: Pipe and water weight supported at nominated levels

objects.name: water-service branch pipe
objects.definition: A pressure-pipe run leaving a main, riser or manifold to supply one fixture group, room, appliance or smaller set of downstream branches.
functions: Divide the water-service network
Supply a defined downstream group
Provide a logical isolation or sizing segment

cad.pattern: Repeated branches from main, riser or manifold
cad.placement: Between a network junction and served fixture group
cad.end: Fixture group, appliance or further branch
cad.opening: Uses coordinated service openings
cad.load: Pressurised pipe supported by building fabric

objects.name: water-distribution manifold
objects.definition: A multi-outlet distribution body receiving one water-service inlet and providing separate branch connections, often with individual isolation or identification for each branch.
functions: Divide one supply into multiple branches
Organise and identify branch services
Provide a compact isolation location where fitted

cad.pattern: One body with repeated outlet ports
cad.placement: Accessible service cupboard, wall box or plant space
cad.opening: Requires an access panel when concealed
cad.load: Supported independently from connected flexible branches

objects.name: fixture water-connection pipe
objects.definition: The final short fixed pipe segment connecting a branch or wall outlet to the fixture isolation point, tap, cistern, appliance or flexible connector.
functions: Complete the final water connection
Position the service connection at the fixture
Provide a stable endpoint for valve or connector

cad.pattern: One or more final connection points per fixture or appliance
cad.placement: At the service face behind, below or beside the fixture
cad.opening: Emerges through lining with escutcheon or sealed penetration where required
cad.load: Connection forces restrained by backing or pipe support

objects.name: flexible water hose assembly
objects.definition: A manufactured flexible pressure connector with integral end fittings used for the final water connection to a mixer, tap, cistern, appliance or water-heater component.
functions: Accommodate short alignment and installation movement
Connect fixed pipework to equipment
Allow equipment removal when isolated

cad.pattern: One hose per equipment inlet unless a manufactured pair is selected
cad.placement: Visible or accessible final connection without twist, kink or harmful tension
cad.start: Accessible isolation valve or fixed outlet
cad.opening: Requires replacement access and must not be trapped in an inaccessible cavity
cad.load: Contains pressure but should not support equipment weight

notes: The 2025 installation editions add hose classification and isolation requirements; project edition selection remains explicit.

objects.name: copper water tube
objects.definition: A straight or coiled copper tube selected as pressure pipe for cold, heated or tempered water and joined with compatible capillary, press, compression or threaded transition fittings.
functions: Convey pressurised water
Provide a durable metallic service route
Accept compatible bends, fittings and valves

cad.pattern: Straight lengths or coils cut and joined along the service route
cad.placement: Above or below ground with service-appropriate protection
cad.opening: Protected at penetrations and from incompatible materials
cad.load: Pipe and water mass carried by clips and brackets

notes: Copper is material, while cold, heated and tempered water are service roles applied to each modelled pipe run.

objects.name: cross-linked polyethylene water pipe
objects.definition: A flexible or semi-rigid cross-linked polyethylene pressure pipe used with its compatible fitting system for cold or heated water distribution.
functions: Convey pressurised cold or heated water
Form long flexible runs with fewer intermediate joints
Connect to a compatible manifold or fitting system

cad.pattern: Long curved runs from manifolds or branches to fixtures
cad.placement: Protected within approved building service zones
cad.opening: Sleeved or protected at penetrations and movement points
cad.load: Flexible pressurised pipe supported to control sag and movement

notes: The fitting system and pipe are selected together; similar-looking press fittings are not assumed interchangeable.

objects.name: multilayer composite water pipe
objects.definition: A pressure pipe built from bonded polymer and metal or other material layers, used with its specified fittings for cold and heated water plumbing.
functions: Convey pressurised water
Combine flexibility with shape retention and barrier layers
Connect through a matched fitting system

cad.pattern: Bent or straight continuous runs joined only with compatible fittings
cad.placement: Within protected service zones
cad.opening: Protected at penetrations and concealed transitions
cad.load: Pressurised pipe supported at system-specific centres

objects.name: polyethylene property-service pipe
objects.definition: A polyethylene pressure pipe used mainly below ground for a property water service, rainwater supply, recycled-water supply or another identified pressure application.
functions: Convey pressurised water below ground
Accommodate long buried routes
Connect through compression, electrofusion or compatible mechanical fittings

cad.pattern: Long buried runs with swept changes and discrete fittings
cad.placement: Below ground between source, meter and building entry
cad.opening: Sleeved at entries and protected from point loads
cad.load: Internal pressure plus soil and external load actions

notes: Colour and stripe indicate intended service but do not replace product and connection evidence.

objects.name: PVC pressure water pipe
objects.definition: A rigid PVC pressure pipe selected for an approved cold-water, recycled-water, rainwater or other pressure service and joined with matching solvent-cement or rubber-ring fittings.
functions: Convey water under pressure
Form rigid buried or protected service runs
Connect to matched PVC pressure fittings

cad.pattern: Straight rigid lengths joined by fittings and sockets
cad.placement: Usually buried or otherwise protected from heat and sunlight according to selected product
cad.opening: Sleeved at structure and protected from incompatible movements
cad.load: Internal pressure, thrust and external ground actions

notes: DWV, stormwater and pressure PVC pipes can look alike but have different service and performance evidence.

objects.name: water-service pressure-pipe fitting
objects.definition: A manufactured pressure-rated component that joins, turns, divides, reduces, closes or adapts water-service pipes while maintaining the selected service pressure and material compatibility.
functions: Change pipe direction or size
Join or divide pressure pipes
Connect pipe systems to valves and equipment

cad.pattern: Discrete component at every direction, branch, size or system transition
cad.placement: Inline with compatible pressure pipe
cad.opening: Internal waterway remains aligned and unobstructed
cad.load: Pressure thrust and operating forces restrained by pipework and supports

objects.name: water-pipe elbow
objects.definition: A pressure fitting with two ends that turns a water-service pipe through a manufactured angle without creating a branch.
functions: Change pipe direction
Maintain a continuous pressure waterway
Connect two compatible pipe segments

cad.pattern: At discrete pipe turns
cad.placement: Between compatible pipe ends
cad.opening: Internal bore follows fitting centreline
cad.load: Pressure thrust restrained by joint and supports

objects.name: water-pipe tee
objects.definition: A three-ended pressure fitting that creates a branch from a water-service pipe or joins two branches into a common run.
functions: Create a branch connection
Join pressure-pipe runs
Maintain a sealed pressure waterway

cad.pattern: At each three-way pressure-pipe node
cad.placement: Inline with main run and branch
cad.start: Main inlet or either run end
cad.opening: Three communicating internal bores
cad.load: Branch thrust and pipe forces restrained locally

objects.name: water-pipe coupling
objects.definition: A straight pressure-rated connector joining two aligned pipe ends of the same or compatible size and material system.
functions: Join aligned pipe lengths
Repair or extend a pressure-pipe run
Maintain waterway continuity

cad.pattern: At straight joins between pipe lengths
cad.placement: Centred over aligned pipe ends
cad.opening: Straight through-bore
cad.load: Axial and pressure forces transferred through the joint

objects.name: water-pipe union
objects.definition: A demountable three-part or equivalent straight connector that lets pipework or equipment be separated without rotating or cutting the connected pipe runs.
functions: Provide a removable inline connection
Allow valve or equipment replacement
Maintain a sealed pressure joint when assembled

cad.pattern: At removable equipment and valve connections
cad.placement: Inline with accessible nut or release mechanism
cad.opening: Through-bore sealed at the union face
cad.load: Pressure force carried through joined tails and nut

objects.name: water-pipe reducer
objects.definition: A pressure fitting joining two different nominal pipe sizes along one water-service run.
functions: Change the water-service pipe size
Connect differently sized components
Maintain a sealed transition

cad.pattern: At nominated pipe-size transitions
cad.placement: Inline between different pipe sizes
cad.opening: Tapered internal waterway
cad.load: Pressure thrust restrained through joints

objects.name: water-pipe adaptor
objects.definition: A pressure fitting connecting different pipe materials, joint systems, thread forms or equipment connections without treating unlike ends as directly interchangeable.
functions: Transition between connection systems
Connect pipe to valve or equipment
Maintain pressure and material compatibility

cad.pattern: At each pipe-material, joint or equipment transition
cad.placement: Inline between unlike compatible ends
cad.opening: Through-bore aligned across transition
cad.load: Joint forces and differential movement restrained or accommodated

objects.name: water-pipe end cap or plug
objects.definition: A pressure-rated cap or plug that closes the open end or unused socket of a water-service pipe or fitting.
functions: Seal an unused pipe end
Close a future branch or test point
Contain service pressure

cad.pattern: At every intentionally closed pressure-pipe end
cad.placement: On compatible pipe or fitting end
cad.opening: No through opening when installed
cad.load: Full end thrust resisted by cap and joint

objects.name: press-joint water fitting
objects.definition: A metal or composite water-service fitting permanently joined by mechanically pressing its socket and seal onto a compatible prepared pipe end.
functions: Join compatible pressure pipe without brazing
Create a permanent sealed fitting connection
Connect pipes to branches, valves or equipment

cad.pattern: At each selected press-system joint
cad.placement: Around fully inserted compatible pipe ends
cad.opening: Internal bore and seal remain aligned
cad.load: Pressure and axial loads transferred through pressed sockets

notes: Press profile, fitting brand family and pipe material are compatibility data; appearance alone is insufficient.

objects.name: compression water-pipe fitting
objects.definition: A demountable or semi-demountable pressure fitting that seals and grips a compatible pipe by tightening a nut onto an olive, compression ring or collet assembly.
functions: Join pressure pipe mechanically
Connect pipe without heat or solvent
Permit service disconnection where the selected fitting allows

cad.pattern: At mechanical joins and transitions
cad.placement: Around prepared compatible pipe ends with tool access
cad.opening: Through-bore retained through insert or body
cad.load: Pressure and pull-out loads resisted by compression assembly

objects.name: electrofusion water-pipe fitting
objects.definition: A polyethylene fitting containing electrical resistance elements that heat and fuse the fitting to prepared compatible PE pipe ends.
functions: Create a fused PE pressure joint
Join or branch buried PE service pipe
Provide a permanent sealed connection

cad.pattern: At nominated PE pipe joints and branches
cad.placement: Around prepared PE pipe ends with fusion clearance
cad.opening: Continuous fused internal waterway
cad.load: Pressure and axial loads transferred through fusion zone

notes: Fusion preparation and trace records are process evidence, while fitting body and terminals are physical objects.

objects.name: water-pipe flange joint assembly
objects.definition: A demountable pressure joint formed by two matching flange faces, gasket, bolts, nuts and washers connecting pipework to pipework, valves, pumps or tanks.
functions: Provide a removable large or equipment connection
Compress a gasket between aligned faces
Transfer pressure and pipe forces through bolts and flanges

cad.pattern: At selected removable equipment and pipe joints
cad.placement: Across two aligned flanged ends with bolt access
cad.opening: Central bores aligned through compressed gasket
cad.load: Pressure thrust and pipe forces transferred through flange bolts

objects.name: water-pipe clip
objects.definition: A repeated clamp or clip fixing a water pipe to building structure while controlling its position, sag and movement without damaging the pipe or insulation.
functions: Support pipe and contained water
Maintain alignment and spacing
Allow or restrain movement according to support role

cad.pattern: Repeated along pipe runs and at fittings or changes as selected
cad.placement: Around pipe and fixed to wall, framing, slab or bracket
cad.opening: Closes around pipe without crushing it
cad.load: Transfers pipe and water weight plus movement reactions to structure

objects.name: water-pipe support bracket
objects.definition: A fabricated or proprietary bracket projecting from or spanning between structure to carry one or more pipe clips, valves, manifolds or water-service equipment.
functions: Bridge from structure to service support position
Carry pipe clips and equipment
Maintain clearance from building surfaces

cad.pattern: At nominated support points and equipment groups
cad.placement: Anchored to building structure adjacent to the service route
cad.end: Pipe clip or equipment mounting point
cad.opening: May contain repeated holes or channels for adjustable fixings
cad.load: Transfers service loads and operating reactions to structure

objects.name: water-pipe penetration sleeve
objects.definition: A larger protective tube cast, built or fitted through a wall, floor, footing or similar element so a water pipe can pass without direct damaging contact and with space for sealing or movement.
functions: Protect a pipe at a building penetration
Separate service pipe from structure or incompatible material
Provide space for seal, insulation or movement

cad.pattern: One sleeve at each selected structural or envelope penetration
cad.placement: Through the host element around the service pipe
cad.opening: Defines the penetration and annular sealing space
cad.load: Does not normally support the service unless specifically designed

notes: Fire, acoustic, waterproof and termite treatments are separate systems coordinated around the sleeve.

objects.name: water-pipe thermal insulation
objects.definition: A continuous or sectional insulating layer fitted around cold, heated or tempered water pipe and selected fittings to limit heat gain, heat loss, condensation or freezing exposure.
functions: Reduce unwanted heat transfer
Limit surface condensation where applicable
Protect service temperature and energy performance

cad.pattern: Continuous shell around nominated pipe and fitting runs
cad.placement: Outside the service pipe with sealed joins and selected removable equipment covers
cad.opening: Interrupted and sealed around supports, valves and branches
cad.load: Non-structural layer protected from compression by supports

notes: Insulation belongs to a pipe segment and service condition; it is not inferred from pipe colour.

objects.name: water-service pipe identification marker
objects.definition: A durable label, band, printed legend, sleeve colour or marker fixed to a pipe or outlet so the carried water service and flow direction can be recognised.
functions: Identify service type
Distinguish rainwater or non-drinking water from drinking water
Assist safe operation and maintenance

cad.pattern: Repeated at accessible intervals, branches, entries and outlets
cad.placement: On the outside surface of service pipe, valve or outlet
cad.load: No load-bearing role

notes: The object is the physical marker; the service assignment remains model metadata on the pipe itself.

objects.name: water-service isolation valve
objects.definition: A manually or automatically operated inline valve used to stop flow to a service, zone, branch, appliance or backflow device for maintenance or emergency control.
functions: Stop or restore water flow
Isolate a defined downstream section
Provide safe testing and maintenance access

cad.pattern: At service, zone, branch and equipment isolation points
cad.placement: Inline in an accessible part of the water service
cad.opening: Operating handle and removal space remain clear
cad.load: Pressure component supported against operating torque and pipe strain

notes: Isolation is a role; ball, gate and stop valves are physical mechanisms that may perform it.

objects.name: ball isolation valve
objects.definition: A quarter-turn inline valve using a bored rotating ball to open or close a water-service flow path.
functions: Provide rapid full-bore isolation
Show operating state through handle position
Permit maintenance of downstream equipment

cad.pattern: At selected isolation points
cad.placement: Inline with handle swing and service access
cad.opening: Bored ball aligns or closes across the waterway
cad.load: Pressure and operating torque carried by body and supports

objects.name: gate isolation valve
objects.definition: A multi-turn inline valve that raises or lowers a gate across the waterway to isolate a water service with relatively little obstruction when fully open.
functions: Isolate a water-service run
Provide a full-open flow path
Allow controlled multi-turn operation

cad.pattern: At selected main or equipment isolation points
cad.placement: Inline with spindle and operating clearance
cad.opening: Gate travels across internal waterway
cad.load: Pressure and spindle forces carried by valve body and supports

objects.name: fixture mini stop valve
objects.definition: A small accessible isolation valve fitted close to a tap, mixer, cistern or appliance inlet to shut off that individual fixture connection.
functions: Isolate one fixture or appliance
Provide a connection for a flexible hose
Permit local replacement without shutting the whole service

cad.placement: Accessible inline in circulation return
cad.opening: Adjustment and test points remain accessible
cad.load: Valve supported against adjustment and pipe forces

objects.name: above-ground rainwater tank
objects.definition: A rainwater-storage vessel installed mainly above finished ground, with visible walls, roof or cover, inlet, overflow, outlet, drain and maintenance access.
functions: Store roof-collected rainwater
Keep stored water enclosed
Supply a rainwater or alternative cold-water service

cad.pattern: One or more tanks linked at designed high and low connections
cad.placement: On a level structural base with access around connections and cover
cad.opening: Sealed access plus screened inlet, overflow and vent openings
cad.load: Full water mass transferred through tank base to support

objects.name: buried rainwater tank
objects.definition: A rainwater-storage vessel installed below or partly below finished ground with an access riser and cover, designed for surrounding soil, groundwater and any surface loading conditions.
functions: Store roof-collected rainwater below ground
Resist earth and groundwater actions
Provide accessible screened inlet, overflow, outlet and cleaning access

cad.pattern: One or more buried vessels connected by drainage and service pipes
cad.placement: In engineered excavation clear of incompatible loads and services
cad.opening: Access riser reaches finished surface; other penetrations remain watertight and screened
cad.load: Soil, groundwater, surface and internal water loads resisted by vessel and foundation

notes: A surface tank cannot be treated as a buried product by moving it below ground in the model.

objects.name: slimline rainwater tank
objects.definition: A narrow above-ground rainwater tank shaped to fit beside a wall or within a restricted side setback while retaining its required inlet, overflow, outlet and access fittings.
functions: Store rainwater in a narrow footprint
Fit constrained external spaces
Connect to roof drainage and rainwater service
not_synonyms: ordinary tank made narrow by scaling

cad.pattern: Single tank or linked narrow modules
cad.placement: On a level base beside a building with inspection and wall clearances
cad.opening: Top access and screened inlet and overflow
cad.load: Full water mass transferred through narrow tank feet or base

objects.name: flexible bladder rainwater tank
objects.definition: A closed flexible water-storage bladder installed within a protected underfloor or framed enclosure and connected to separate inlet, vent, overflow and outlet fittings.
functions: Store rainwater in a low flexible vessel
Expand and contract with stored volume
Use protected spaces unsuitable for rigid upright tanks where approved

cad.pattern: One flexible vessel expanding within its protected maximum envelope
cad.placement: On a smooth level protected surface with full access to all ports
cad.opening: Closed bladder with sealed service ports
cad.load: Distributed water load transferred across supporting surface

notes: Product-specific enclosure, support, access and water-use approval are required; a generic flexible bag is not assumed suitable.

objects.name: rainwater tank body
objects.definition: The water-retaining wall and base shell of a rainwater tank, excluding removable covers, separate fittings, pumps and external support construction.
functions: Contain stored rainwater
Resist hydrostatic and external actions
Receive sealed tank fittings

cad.pattern: One shell per tank module
cad.placement: On base or within engineered excavation
cad.opening: Contains purpose-made inlet, overflow, outlet, drain and access openings
cad.load: Contains water pressure and transfers full load to support

objects.name: rainwater tank access cover
objects.definition: A removable, hinged or bolted cover closing the tank inspection and cleaning opening while preventing entry by children, animals, insects, light and surface water as applicable.
functions: Close the maintenance opening
Permit tank inspection and cleaning
Exclude contaminants and unauthorised entry

cad.pattern: One or more covers at nominated access openings
cad.placement: Across tank or riser access opening
cad.opening: Opens for maintenance and seals when closed
cad.load: Selected surface loads transferred to cover frame

objects.name: buried-tank access riser
objects.definition: A vertical neck extending a buried rainwater tank's access opening up to finished surface level and supporting its removable cover.
functions: Bring tank access to the surface
Keep soil and surface water out of the access path
Support and locate the access cover

cad.pattern: One vertical riser above each buried access opening
cad.placement: Between tank crown and finished surface
cad.opening: Maintains clear access opening through soil cover
cad.load: Surface loads carried through rated cover and riser arrangement

objects.name: rainwater tank inlet fitting
objects.definition: A sealed or screened fitting where roof-water pipework enters the rainwater tank, directing inflow through the selected strainer, calming inlet or first-flush arrangement.
functions: Connect roof drainage to storage
Direct inflow into the tank
Support inlet screening and sealed tank entry

cad.pattern: At each roof-water entry connection
cad.placement: Near tank top or approved inlet level
cad.opening: Forms a sealed or screened tank penetration
cad.load: Pipe and fitting supported without stressing tank wall

objects.name: rainwater tank inlet strainer
objects.definition: A removable basket, screen or mesh at a tank inlet that catches leaves and coarse debris while allowing roof water to enter storage.
functions: Remove coarse debris from inflow
Prevent animals and insects entering through the inlet
Provide a cleanable inlet surface

cad.pattern: One removable screen at each open tank inlet
cad.placement: Across inlet opening above stored water
cad.opening: Mesh openings pass water while excluding debris and animals
cad.load: Wet debris load carried by basket rim or frame

objects.name: rainwater first-flush diverter
objects.definition: A branch chamber or diversion device that intercepts the initial roof runoff and releases, drains or isolates it before cleaner continuing flow enters the rainwater tank.
functions: Divert the initial contaminated roof runoff
Reduce debris and pollutants reaching storage
Reset or drain ready for the next rainfall event

cad.pattern: One or more devices on roof-water branches before tank inlet
cad.placement: Upstream of storage with drain and cleaning access
cad.opening: Contains overflow, drain and cleaning openings
cad.load: Filled chamber mass transferred to brackets or ground support

notes: The phrase first flush also describes flushing water from a drinking tap; the rainwater-diversion device is a separate object.

objects.name: rainwater tank calming inlet
objects.definition: A downward inlet pipe and shaped outlet near the tank floor that slows incoming rainwater and directs it without strongly disturbing settled material.
functions: Carry inflow toward the tank bottom
Reduce turbulence and sediment disturbance
Direct inflow away from tank walls and suction point

cad.pattern: One internal drop and diffuser per selected inlet
cad.placement: Inside tank from inlet level to near floor
cad.opening: Outlet remains above sediment zone and unobstructed
cad.load: Pipe and hydraulic reaction carried by tank-side supports

notes: A calming inlet is good-practice treatment hardware, not a universal NCC-prescribed part for every tank.

objects.name: rainwater tank floating intake
objects.definition: A buoyant screened suction fitting connected by flexible hose so water is drawn from below the surface rather than from settled material at the tank bottom.
functions: Draw water from a selected upper storage zone
Keep the suction screen away from floor sediment
Move with changing water level

cad.pattern: One floating intake per selected tank suction
cad.placement: Inside tank moving vertically with water surface
cad.end: Fixed tank outlet through flexible hose
cad.opening: Screened suction openings remain submerged
cad.load: Buoyancy supports intake; hose reactions transferred to tank outlet

notes: Selected product and intended water use determine material and screening requirements.

objects.name: rainwater tank service outlet fitting
objects.definition: A sealed low or intermediate-level fitting through the tank wall that connects stored water to a pump suction, gravity tap or rainwater service.
functions: Provide a controlled service connection from storage
Seal the tank-wall penetration
Connect isolation and suction pipework
materials: lead-free metal or compatible polymer bulkhead fitting

cad.pattern: One or more outlets per tank service
cad.placement: Through tank wall above sediment or at selected pickup level
cad.opening: Sealed circular tank penetration
cad.load: Pipe reactions restrained without distorting tank wall

objects.name: rainwater tank overflow fitting
objects.definition: A high-level tank outlet and connecting pipe that releases inflow above the maximum retained water level to an approved stormwater path without uncontrolled spill at the tank.
functions: Set the normal maximum retained water level
Discharge excess inflow
Connect screened overflow to stormwater disposal

cad.pattern: One or more high-level overflow paths sized for selected inflow
cad.placement: At tank high-water level falling to approved stormwater point
cad.opening: High-level outlet remains screened and unobstructed
cad.load: Overflow flow and pipe mass carried by supports

objects.name: rainwater tank mosquito-proof screen
objects.definition: A closely fitted insect-resistant mesh closing a rainwater tank inlet, overflow, vent or other opening while preserving the required water or air flow area.
functions: Prevent mosquito and insect entry
Exclude small animals and debris
Maintain screened hydraulic or ventilation flow

cad.pattern: At every tank opening needing insect exclusion
cad.placement: Fully across inlet, overflow, vent or access opening with sealed perimeter
cad.opening: Mesh apertures preserve required water or air path
cad.load: Debris load carried by frame; not a structural cover

notes: Mesh aperture, material, edge gaps and maintenance condition are required; a generic flyscreen texture is not sufficient evidence.

objects.name: rainwater tank vent
objects.definition: A screened air opening or short vent pipe that lets air enter and leave a closed rainwater tank as the water level changes.
functions: Equalise tank air pressure
Support inflow and outflow without tank vacuum or pressure
Exclude insects and animals through screening

cad.pattern: One or more air openings per closed tank
cad.placement: At tank high level clear of surface water and contaminants
cad.opening: Screened air path remains unobstructed
cad.load: No structural role beyond self-support

objects.name: rainwater tank drain or scour outlet
objects.definition: A low-level valved outlet used to empty or flush settled material and cleaning water from a rainwater tank independently of its normal service outlet.
functions: Drain the tank for cleaning or repair
Remove low-level sediment and wash water
Provide a controlled maintenance discharge

cad.pattern: One low-level maintenance outlet per tank or linked tank group
cad.placement: At accessible tank low point
cad.end: Capped valve or controlled drain route
cad.opening: Normally closed; opened for maintenance
cad.load: Full hydrostatic pressure resisted by valve and tank fitting

objects.name: rainwater tank level gauge
objects.definition: A mechanical, pneumatic, ultrasonic or electronic device physically connected to or aimed into a rainwater tank to indicate its stored water level.
functions: Indicate stored water level
Support pump and top-up operation
Make available volume visible to occupants or controls

cad.pattern: One or more gauges per tank group
cad.placement: On tank wall or top with sensor path into storage
cad.opening: Any penetration remains sealed and insect resistant
cad.load: Instrument self-weight carried by tank mounting

notes: A level reading is a state attribute; the gauge and sensor are physical objects.

objects.name: rainwater pressure-pump assembly
objects.definition: A pump with suction strainer, isolation, non-return protection, pressure controller and optional vessel that draws from rainwater storage and supplies the rainwater-service pipework.
functions: Draw water from storage
Raise pressure for building outlets
Start, stop and protect the pump according to demand and water availability

cad.pattern: One duty pump or selected multi-pump set per rainwater service
cad.placement: Beside, above or within the tank with access, drainage and ventilation
cad.opening: Suction, discharge, electrical and drain interfaces
cad.load: Pump mass and vibration transferred through base, brackets or submersible supports

objects.name: rainwater pump controller
objects.definition: A pressure, flow or level-responsive controller attached to a rainwater pump assembly to start and stop the pump and provide dry-run or fault protection.
functions: Start the pump on demand
Stop the pump when demand ends
Protect against dry running and selected faults

cad.pattern: One controller per pump or packaged set
cad.placement: On pump discharge or adjacent control enclosure
cad.opening: Service and reset interfaces remain accessible
cad.load: Small unit supported by pipe or equipment frame

objects.name: mains-to-rainwater switching assembly
objects.definition: A certified valve, break-tank or controller arrangement that maintains supply to selected outlets by changing between rainwater and drinking-water sources without creating an unprotected cross-connection.
functions: Select or automatically change water source
Maintain service when rainwater is unavailable
Protect the drinking-water supply from rainwater backflow

cad.pattern: One certified source-selection assembly per served rainwater service
cad.placement: Accessible near tank pump or building service entry with drainage where required
cad.opening: Air-gap, relief and drain openings remain unobstructed
cad.load: Device and pipe reactions carried by bracket or base

notes: A future tool must never connect the two source pipes directly merely because both feed the same outlets.

objects.name: rainwater tank mains top-up assembly
objects.definition: A controlled drinking-water inlet discharging into rainwater storage through the required physical separation and level control to maintain a minimum tank supply without contaminating the mains.
functions: Add limited mains water to rainwater storage
Maintain a minimum operating volume
Protect the drinking-water inlet through an air gap or selected device

cad.pattern: One top-up path per selected tank group
cad.placement: Above tank maximum water level or through a certified separation device
cad.opening: Visible air separation remains above maximum retained water level
cad.load: Valve and outlet supported independently from tank wall

notes: Top-up water, source switching and normal rainwater inflow are three different hydraulic paths.

objects.name: rainwater top-up float valve
objects.definition: A level-operated inlet valve using a float, arm or remote pilot to open the protected top-up water path when tank level falls and close it at the selected level.
functions: Sense low and restored water levels mechanically
Control top-up inflow
Limit the filled top-up volume below overflow level

cad.pattern: One valve per mechanically controlled top-up inlet
cad.placement: At tank top or separate break-tank chamber with full float travel
cad.opening: Float movement envelope remains clear
cad.load: Water pressure and float forces carried by mounting

objects.name: rainwater tank support base
objects.definition: A level slab, pad, ring beam, compacted base or proprietary frame distributing the full rainwater tank load to ground or building structure without harmful settlement or point loading.
functions: Support the full tank and water mass
Provide a level continuous or designed bearing surface
Maintain tank and pipe alignment

cad.pattern: One continuous or engineered support under each tank
cad.placement: Between tank base and stable ground or structure
cad.opening: May contain drain and anchor penetrations
cad.load: Distributes full tank mass and external actions

objects.name: rainwater tank anchor
objects.definition: A strap, bracket, bolt or proprietary hold-down connecting a rainwater tank to its support to resist wind, movement or other selected actions when the tank is empty or partly full.
functions: Restrain tank sliding or overturning
Transfer selected actions to the support
Maintain pipe and tank alignment

cad.pattern: Repeated around tank according to selected restraint design
cad.placement: Between tank restraint points and structural base
cad.opening: Fastener holes through brackets or base
cad.load: Transfers wind and movement actions into support

objects.name: buried rainwater-tank anti-flotation assembly
objects.definition: An engineered slab, straps, beams or anchoring arrangement holding a buried rainwater tank down against groundwater buoyancy when its stored-water level is low.
functions: Resist tank flotation
Transfer buoyancy into ground or structural ballast
Protect connected pipes from tank movement

cad.pattern: Slab and repeated restraint straps around or over buried tank
cad.placement: Below and around buried tank within engineered excavation
cad.opening: Allows access riser and pipe penetrations without cutting restraints
cad.load: Transfers groundwater buoyancy into ballast and soil

notes: Groundwater and soil conditions are project inputs; no universal anchor geometry is implied.

objects.name: rainwater outlet identification sign
objects.definition: A durable physical label or sign fixed beside a rainwater tap, valve or appliance connection to identify the source and any restricted use.
functions: Identify a rainwater outlet
Warn users where water is not approved for drinking
Support maintenance and cross-connection control

cad.pattern: At each rainwater outlet requiring identification
cad.placement: Immediately adjacent to or on the outlet without obstructing operation
cad.load: No structural role

notes: The sign does not establish water quality; it communicates the approved service assignment.
